text:
Micah: Heads-up — we're getting a few support tickets about embeddings after the model swap today. seems like some customers expect the 1536-d vectors but v2 models return 2048 now. Can docs call this out in the migration guide?
Tara: Ack. I saw one customer with a dimension-mismatch error in their downstream store. Do we know which model aliases changed dims?
Micah: v1-embed-std -> v2-embed-compat swapped to a different architecture. I'll post the model map in a sec.
Micah: model map snippet: `v1-embed-std (1536) -> v2-embed-compat (2048)` — added to the internal model-catalog PR.
Jamal: We should add a clear migration note and example code showing how to handle resizing/upgrading embeddings. Quick idea: show a sample Python snippet that detects dimension and pads/truncs or reruns encode.
Tara: Good. Also need to surface that clients using upsert to vector DBs might need to reindex, and provide a command example for bulk reindex.
Sophia: I'll draft a short FAQ blurb: "Why did my embeddings change size?" + recommended steps (reindex, map old vectors to new model, fall back to older alias if needed). Want me to open a docs PR?
Micah: Yes please. Put it under /docs/guides/migrations/embedding-model-swap.md and add a very small code sample for Postgres + pgvector and for Pinecone. Keep it short.
Tara: Also note an SDK rename: in the v2 client we changed `model` param -> `model_name`. That caused a few widget breaking changes where people pass kwargs through wrappers. Let's include a compatibility tip: `if 'model' in kwargs: kwargs['model_name'] = kwargs.pop('model')`
Jamal: Can we also add a short troubleshooting section for the CLI `ri reindex-embeddings --model <alias>` example? People will search for CLI steps first.
Sophia: On it. I'll add CLI snippet and the kwargs compatibility shim. I'll file the PR and ping here when ready.
docs-bot: PR #482 opened by Sophia: docs/guides/migrations/embedding-model-swap.md
Micah: Thanks. Two other asks: 1) deadline — can we merge today? Support needs the note in the public docs before EOD. 2) Update the deprecation notice for the old alias so it links to the migration guide.
Sophia: EOD merge possible if Jamal and Tara can quick review. Draft is ~220 lines with examples and FAQ.
Jamal: I'll do a review now. Focus on correctness of the DB examples and the CLI flags.
Tara: I'll check language and whether we should mention cost implications of the new model (slightly higher).
Jamal: Reviewed — left two tiny nit comments on Postgres snippet (connection string note) and a suggested wording for reindex caveat.
Sophia: Addressed comments, pushed commit. PR #482 now at 3 commits.
docs-bot: PR #482 updated (3 commits) by Sophia
Micah: Great. Tara, can you sign off on wording? If yes I'll request engineering to update alias-deprecation notice to point to this doc.
Tara: Signed off. Small wording tweak accepted.
Micah: OK I'm updating the deprecation notice in the internal policy doc to link to the new migration page and adding a short timeline: "alias v1-embed-std marked deprecated today; recommended to reindex within 30 days".
Sophia: Merged PR #482 — added redirect and YAML frontmatter.
docs-bot: PR #482 merged by Sophia
Jamal: I'll add a short SDK snippet to the SDK repo showing the compatibility shim and a unit test suggestion. Will open a follow-up PR there.
Micah: Perf. After SDK PR lands, let's add a one-liner in the migration page referencing the SDK patch version that contains the shim.
Tara: Also open a short internal note for support with copy/paste replies for customers. Micah, can you or Jamal draft?
Micah: I'll draft the support template now and drop into #support.
Sophia: Thanks everyone — this should cut down on the tickets. Closing loop once SDK PR merges.
Micah: Closing thread — will follow up on SDK PR number when available.
